offer.text: Winter's biting and the elders shiver. Weave me 6 carpets and I'll see them warmed.

accept.text: Soft and thick, mind. Old bones feel the cold.

decline.text: They'll huddle closer to the fire, I suppose.

ready.text: Six warm carpets! No elder freezes on my watch — or yours.

complete.text: You've warmed more than feet today. Thank you.
